entradas.text: "Especially all that lobbying work. But it's nothing to break me down, sir. Trust me, I'm fine."
"Anything you want to say before we go in?"
entradas.menu: "Anything you want to say before we go in?"

entradas.text: "Thank you, Lucian. You look tired. How are you holding up?"
entradas.menu: "Thank you, Lucian. You look tired. How are you holding up?"

entradas.text: "I couldn't have done it without you."
entradas.menu: "I couldn't have done it without you."

entradas.text: "It's nothing, sir. I am ready and able as always."
"Of course, sir."
"Good to know. I need you at your full potential."
entradas.menu: "Good to know. I need you at your full potential."

entradas.text: "I hope so, Lucian. I can't have my team get worn out at a time like this."
entradas.menu: "I hope so, Lucian. I can't have my team get worn out at a time like this."

entradas.text: "Are you sure? You can be honest with me."
entradas.menu: "Are you sure? You can be honest with me."

entradas.text: "Of course, sir."
"I'm always honest with you, sir."
"Of course, sir."
"Of course, sir. I'll be doing my best."
"I think we should go, sir. Mr. Vice President must have started the session already."
"Please sir, don't be like that. You'll get through this."
"I think we should go, sir. Vice President Vectern must have started the session already."
"I think we should go, sir. Mr. Vice President must have started the session already."
"No, sir. Just keep your cool with the cabinet. I believe concerns will be raised in the meeting."
"I can't let them bring you down however they like. We must resist."
"Of course, sir."
"No, sir. Everything is under control. But I'm sure the ministers will raise their concerns at the meeting."
He gestured at the door with the files he held.
"There's not much to say, sir. We should find a way to restrain the Supreme Court from impeaching you."
He gestured to the door.
"I have already been doing my best to find ways around it. Please stay composed and do not worry."
"Thank you, Lucian."
entradas.menu: "Thank you, Lucian."

entradas.text: "It is an emergency... What do they expect?"
entradas.menu: "It is an emergency... What do they expect?"

entradas.text: "They don't even have the guts to face me. If the party doesn't fall in line, we must consider radical changes."
entradas.menu: "They don't even have the guts to face me. If the party doesn't fall in line, we must consider radical changes."

entradas.text: "I'll admit, this last year was tough."
He gestured to the door.
He stared down at the floor for a few seconds and then gestured at the door with the files he held.
"Especially all that work with the Old Guard. But it's nothing to break me down, sir. Trust me."
"We need their trust. We have to do something to prove our capabilities."
entradas.menu: "We need their trust. We have to do something to prove our capabilities."

entradas.text: "Alright. Let's go to the meeting and hear these concerns out."
entradas.menu: "Alright. Let's go to the meeting and hear these concerns out."

entradas.text: He fixed his tie.
"Some Sollists have also been nagging our ministers about the short-lived state of emergency, which they believe has only worsened the situation."
"I'm afraid we're trapped. Our future is up to the Old Guard now."
entradas.menu: "I'm afraid we're trapped. Our future is up to the Old Guard now."

entradas.text: "Alright. Let's get on with this meeting then."
entradas.menu: "Alright. Let's get on with this meeting then."

entradas.text: "We will resist, Lucian. Don't you worry. Nothing will happen to us."
entradas.menu: "We will resist, Lucian. Don't you worry. Nothing will happen to us."

entradas.text: "Alright, let's go in and hear them out."
entradas.menu: "Alright, let's go in and hear them out."

entradas.text: "What concerns?"
entradas.menu: "What concerns?"

entradas.text: "Concerns? It doesn't sound like everything is under control."
entradas.menu: "Concerns? It doesn't sound like everything is under control."

entradas.text: "Thank you for your trust in me. However, this is a very important matter, sir. I cannot take it easy."
"Such radical changes towards the end of our term is not advised, sir. But we could talk about these in the meeting."
"Our failure of the reforms had a huge impact on public opinion. And also on some of the ministers, from the looks of it."
"Of course, sir. Let's discuss that in the meeting."
"The cabinet has gathered in the White Room, sir."
"I'm ready. Let's go."
entradas.menu: "I'm ready. Let's go."

entradas.text: "The Vice President will be opening the session soon. We can go in whenever you're ready."
"They don't even have the guts to face me. If the party doesn't fall in line, we must consider radical changes."
entradas.menu: "They don't even have the guts to face me. If the party doesn't fall in line, we must consider radical changes."

entradas.text: "The party is quite discontent about the whole situation. They believe your presidency has destroyed the USP's prestige."
Lucian stood upright, holding a large folder of files under his arm. He bowed in acknowledgement.
"You already knew and expected this, I presume. I just wanted to give you a heads up."
"We need their trust. We have to do something to prove our capabilities."
entradas.menu: "We need their trust. We have to do something to prove our capabilities."

entradas.text: "No, sir. I don't believe there's anything we didn't expect. However, our failure of the reforms had a huge impact on public opinion."
"Of course, sir."
"I only want to congratulate you again, sir. You wrote history."
"Alright, let's go in and hear them out."
entradas.menu: "Alright, let's go in and hear them out."

entradas.text: "Of course, sir."
"Alright. Let's go to the meeting and hear these concerns out."
entradas.menu: "Alright. Let's go to the meeting and hear these concerns out."

entradas.text: "Such radical change towards the end of our term is not advised, sir. But we could talk about this in the meeting."
"We have done it together."
entradas.menu: "We have done it together."

entradas.text: "But we can't allow them to bring you down however they like. We must resist."
"Do you really think they can impeach me?"
entradas.menu: "Do you really think they can impeach me?"

entradas.text: "It doesn't sound like it's going well."
entradas.menu: "It doesn't sound like it's going well."

entradas.text: "I trust you Lucian. Take it easy."
entradas.menu: "I trust you Lucian. Take it easy."

entradas.text: "Of course, sir. Let's discuss that in the meeting."
"The investigation has already been opened against you, sir. But I'm sure nothing will come out of it."
"You are right, sir."
"I think we should go, sir. Vice President Vectern must have started the session already."
"What concerns?"
entradas.menu: "What concerns?"

entradas.text: "What are you saying? Should I be expecting something?"
entradas.menu: "What are you saying? Should I be expecting something?"

entradas.text: "No, sir. Thank *you* for reforming the constitution."
"They declared that the state of emergency was unlawful, sir. Theoretically, they can do that."
He slightly bowed his head.
"The party is quite discontent about the administration since we have not pursued any constitutional reforms. They believe your presidency has destroyed the USP's prestige."
"We can't let them bring you down however they like. We must resist."
He gestured to the door.
"There are members of the cabinet that are quite discontent about the state of emergency, sir."
He looked exhausted.
He looked exhausted.

He looked exhausted.
